{{Quote|I once read claims of a forgotten Jedi world deep within the Unknown Regions&hellip; perhaps we'll seek it out.|Jedi Master Gnost-Dural|<ref name="Jedi Under Siege" />}}
A forgotten '''Jedi world''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that was claimed to exist in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Gnost-Dural]] suggested this planet as a possible destination for the evacuation during the [[Invasion of Ossus]]<ref name="Jedi Under Siege" /> in [[3628 BBY]].<ref name="TORDate">{{TOR_updates|5.10.0}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Jedi world was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity in [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', specifically the<ref name="Jedi Under Siege" /> [[2018]]<ref name="JUS Release Date">{{TORweb|url=info/news/news-article/20181211-0|text='Jedi Under Siege' Update – Play Now!}}</ref> 5.10 ''Jedi Under Siege'' update to the [[2016]] [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne|''Knights of the Eternal Throne'']] expansion.<ref name="Jedi Under Siege" />
